run_tool_calling_chat_completion: run the vllm example to generate chat completions with required tool calling using the OpenAI client
create_openai_client_for_vllm: create an OpenAI client configured to connect to a local vllm server at localhost 8000
list_available_models: list the available models served by the vllm OpenAI-compatible API endpoint
stream_tool_calls: stream chat completion tool call chunks from vllm using tool choice required and streaming enabled
generate_non_streaming_tool_calls: generate non-streaming chat completion tool calls from vllm with tool choice required for weather tools
